evidence.reason: Left edit drops reminders.initialize() and switches the calendar argument from "work" to "benchmark", changing the path exercised by the test assert.ok(await scheduledDelay(40) > 0).
Right edit changes the default multiplier from configuration.rate to 0, which alters the priorities[0] term used in the return expression whenever the default is taken.

Tests assert evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0, reminderQuote(30, 0.1, "work").amount > 0, and scheduledDelay(40) > 0, so both the "work" calendar path and the default multiplier path are jointly relied upon.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动分别移除了初始化调用、把日历参数从 work 改成 benchmark，并把默认 multiplier 从 configuration.rate 改成 0，而现有测试仍依赖 work 路径和默认乘数，合并后行为是否仍满足断言无法从给定证据确定。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay 恢复 reminders.initialize() 并保留 "work" 日历参数，同时 src/reminders.ts#reminderDelay 将默认 multiplier 改回 configuration.rate，或补充测试明确 benchmark 路径与默认乘数的预期行为。
